mentions.name: CDCL SAT solver
mentions.description: A from-scratch CDCL (conflict-driven clause learning) SAT solver, following the author's earlier experiments with DP and DPLL SAT solvers. Work in progress, currently focused on deriving the learned clause after a conflict.
mentions.source_excerpt: Attemping to write my own CDCL SAT solver right now. I've experimented in the past with a DP & DPLL SAT solver. I'm currently somewhat mentally stuck on how to create the derived clause after a conflict, but I'll get there :)
